name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 82 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.4 days starting 2025-07-31, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
